details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders

SELECT SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS total_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders
SELECT AVG(total_amount) AS avg_order_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid'

SELECT c.city, SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY c.city

SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY p.category

SELECT c.segment, AVG(o.total_amount) AS aov
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY c.segment

SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) AS month, SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2025
GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date)
ORDER BY month

SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.qty) AS total_quantity
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id)
SELECT channel, AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'refunded' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS refund_rate FROM orders GROUP BY channel
SELECT reason, SUM(amount) AS total_refund_amount FROM refunds GROUP BY reason

SELECT c.city
FROM refunds r
JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.city
ORDER BY SUM(r.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) AS month, channel, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2025
GROUP BY month, channel
ORDER BY month, channel

SELECT SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) - oi.qty * p.cost) AS total_gross_margin
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'

SELECT c.customer_id, c.name
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
SELECT AVG(discount) AS avg_discount_rate FROM order_items

SELECT p.brand, SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE p.category = 'Electronics' AND o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY p.brand
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders o
WHERE o.status = 'refunded'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id
  )
SELECT median(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid'

SELECT c.segment, SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) / (SELECT SUM(oi2.qty * oi2.unit_price * (1 - oi2.discount)) FROM order_items oi2 JOIN orders o2 ON oi2.order_id = o2.order_id WHERE o2.status = 'paid') AS revenue_share FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.segment

SELECT p.category, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customer_count
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY p.category

SELECT month, revenue, (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS mom_growth
FROM (
  SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) AS month,
         SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2025
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date)
) t
ORDER BY month

SELECT p.category
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY AVG(oi.unit_price) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' AND total_amount > 500

SELECT QUARTER(signup_date) AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS new_customers
FROM customers
WHERE YEAR(signup_date) = 2024
GROUP BY QUARTER(signup_date)
ORDER BY quarter
SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN channel = 'app' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS app_paid_order_fraction FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid'
SELECT customer_id, MAX(order_date) AS most_recent_order_date FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id
SELECT SUM(oi.qty) FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.product_id NOT IN (SELECT oi2.product_id FROM order_items oi2 JOIN refunds r ON oi2.order_id = r.order_id)

SELECT c.city, AVG(o.total_amount) AS avg_order_value
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY c.city
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC
LIMIT 3
